decisions.reason: Changing who applies edits to the Back to School page does not alter the selected keyword or its mapped page.
The source concerns delivery of edits for the Back to School page and does not necessarily change the separate image ALT optimization requirement.
The implementation mode for one landing-page update does not change the requested coverage or type of the on-page SEO report.
The source is scoped by context to pending edits on the Back to School landing page and does not alter the separate previously updated webpage-content requirement.
The Back to School page editing arrangement does not affect backlink quantity or follow-type distribution.
The source decision concerns who applies landing-page edits and does not change blog production or publication obligations.
The landing-page editing workflow does not affect backlink indexing or indexing reporting.
The source does not change the requirement to include search-volume data in the keyword sheet.
The source concerns edits to a landing page, not the internal-link requirements for blog articles.
